1.t: By the fig and the olive,

3.t: And by this land made safe;

4.t: Surely We created man of the best stature

5.t: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,

6.t: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.

7.t: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?

8.t: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
